Overview

FuelGenie is a digital fuel-delivery platform that helps customers order fuel and manage the delivery journey digitally — from onboarding and customer setup, through delivery location and product discovery, to fuel selection, order confirmation and delivery tracking.

My Role

UI/UX Designer

I worked on structuring and designing the mobile experience, focusing on making the fuel ordering journey simple, clear and easy to follow.

  • Mobile UX & UI design
  • User flow design
  • Onboarding experience
  • Customer profile setup
  • Location and delivery experience
  • Fuel ordering flow
  • Order confirmation
  • Delivery tracking
  • Prototyping and visual design
The Challenge

Fuel ordering involves multiple steps before a delivery can be completed — from setting up customer information and delivery location to selecting fuel and confirming an order. The challenge was to create a simple, structured experience while keeping important delivery information visible throughout the journey.

Core User Journey

One connected path, start to delivery

Get Started→ Create Profile→ Set Location→ Explore Products→ Select Fuel→ Confirm Order→ Track Delivery
Key UX Areas
01

Onboarding

Created a focused entry experience that introduces the product and guides customers into the ordering journey.

02

Profile & Location

Structured customer information and delivery-location details so the required information is captured before placing an order.

03

Fuel Selection

Designed the product and fuel-selection experience to make choosing the required fuel and delivery details straightforward.

04

Order Confirmation

Brought important order and delivery information together before the customer confirms the order.

05

Order Status

Provided a clear success state after the order was placed, helping customers understand their request had been received.

06

Live Tracking

Designed the tracking experience to give customers visibility into the delivery journey after placing an order.

Design Focus

Simple Actions

Keep each step focused on the information and action required at that moment.

Clear Delivery Information

Make location, fuel and order details easy to understand before confirmation.

Visible Status

Give customers clear feedback after placing an order and during delivery.

Mobile Usability

Structure important actions and information for a focused mobile experience.

Outcome

Designed a complete mobile fuel-ordering journey from onboarding to delivery tracking, with a focus on reducing friction, improving clarity and helping customers understand what happens at every stage of their order.
